intended_object: A helper quantity used inside one case analysis: the truncated difference C − B of two edge lengths (edges 8 and 3) of a particular genus-4 subdivided graph. It is used in the Case-3 window construction of a low-genus Brill–Noether proof. This reading comes from the docstring and the definitions of B and C in GenusFourRow095.lean.
explanation: This is not a mathematical object to compare against the literature. It is a local abbreviation for `length 8 - length 3` in ℕ, defined for one specific configuration and used only as an intermediate quantity in a proof by cases. Nothing in the literature corresponds to it, and Mathlib has no counterpart. The body matches its docstring ("excess of arm length C over B"). Subtraction in ℕ truncates at zero, which presumably only matters if C < B, a case this Case-3 construction presumably excludes.
